title: Yosoi Benchmark Lab exploratory Baseline v1

claimBoundary.allowed: A current-host optimization baseline for parser, HTTP, and rendered acquisition work.
claimBoundary.disallowed: A public fastest claim, release certification, or a comparison against hosted APIs.

preservedEnvironment.processor: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

knownLimitations: Baseline v1 measures narrow HTML and CSS-shaped extraction tasks; it does not independently benchmark XPath, decoded-text literal or regex extraction, JSON, XML, accessibility trees, streaming evaluation, or typed Contracts/Extractor paths.
The HTTP and rendered Yosoi source revisions were not retained at run time; only the preserved binary hashes and sizes identify those arms.
The Yosoi binaries were local source builds, not published release artifacts.
uv.lock defines future reruns; the original HTTP and rendered runs retained direct versions but not a complete Python transitive freeze at capture time.
Rendered acquisition used the documented emergency rollback Chromium 152 artifact, not the certified Chrome 153 tuple.
All performance and RSS observations come from one workstation and are exploratory.
The direct Playwright control starts its internal timer after browser launch and is a pooled lower-level control, not a product-equivalent arm.
